$comment: SAMPLE roster. The lake-root paths below resolve only in a CONTENT repo (content/<paper>/lean), not in folio-assistant, which has no papers — so this copy is an example for a folio to adapt, not live config. The authoritative roster lives in the content repo alongside the lake-cache-refresh workflow (bean 8agu). scripts/lake-cache.sh does not depend on it: with no roster it infers the package from the lake-cache/<pkg>-<slug> branch family, so a restore works with zero config.
